note: Layout for the interactive site map. Positions are percentages of the map image (x from left, y from top). Status: 'building' = in progress, 'planned' = coming later. Only Academy Plaza is being built first.

districts.name: Academy Plaza
districts.blurb: The heart of Aurel Bay. The academy gates are the safe spawn, rooftops ring two open squares, and the tournament stage sits in the plaza.
features: Safe spawn at the academy gates

districts.name: Academy Hill
districts.blurb: The academy campus on the hill behind the plaza, with training grounds and the courtyard.

districts.name: Gold Harbor
districts.blurb: Docks and cargo cranes on the bay. Tight lanes and stacked containers for close fights.

districts.name: Lantern Market
districts.blurb: Narrow streets of stalls and warm street lamps. Shops and cosmetics vendors live here.

districts.name: Skyline Ward
districts.blurb: Tall towers and rooftop bridges for vertical, dash-heavy fights.

districts.name: Old Quarter
districts.blurb: Stone streets and a ruined shrine where live-event rifts open.
